<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="backends-and-discovery">
<h1>Backends and discovery</h1>
<section id="automatic-selection">
<h2>Automatic selection</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EspeakRuntime(mode=&quot;auto&quot;)</span></code> probes native libraries first, then falls back to the CLI executable. A requested exact capability filters native candidates to libraries exposing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_TextToPhonemesWithTerminator</span></code>; if none is available, auto mode uses CLI best-effort behavior and records both <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RuntimeInfo.fallback_code</span></code> and the detailed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RuntimeInfo.fallback_reason</span></code>. If a selected native library cannot initialize, auto mode uses the same fallback; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode=&quot;native&quot;</span></code> always raises instead.</p>
<p>Explicit constructor arguments override environment configuration. The discovery variables are <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ESPEAKNG_RUNTIME_EXECUTABLE</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ESPEAKNG_RUNTIME_LIBRARY</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ESPEAKNG_RUNTIME_DATA</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="inspection-and-diagnostics">
<h2>Inspection and diagnostics</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">inspect_espeak(...)</span></code> returns an immutable, non-initializing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EspeakInspection</span></code> record. It reports CLI availability independently, the selected native library/source/data, and the ordered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LibraryProbe</span></code> records. Probes distinguish unloadable libraries, missing mandatory native symbols, and missing exact-clause support. Explicit libraries are authoritative and are the only library probed.</p>
<p>Diagnostic source labels such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeakng-loader</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">near-executable</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">system-espeak-ng</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">system-espeak</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">explicit</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cli</span></code> identify discovery paths. They are diagnostic strings, not an enum contract.</p>
</section>
<section id="native-backend">
<h2>Native backend</h2>
<p>The native backend uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ctypes</span></code>. eSpeak’s selected voice and other state are process-global, so native calls share a process-wide lock and native manager. Closing a runtime releases its Python ownership; the initialized native library remains resident for the process lifetime rather than being terminated and reinitialized repeatedly. Compatible runtimes reuse it, and conflicting library or data paths are rejected.</p>
<section id="voice-selector-resolution">
<h3>Voice selector resolution</h3>
<p>The native backend resolves voice selectors using a two-step strategy:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>Name lookup</strong>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_SetVoiceByName(selector)</span></code> — succeeds for explicit eSpeak voice names and identifiers.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Language property fallback</strong>: when name lookup fails and the native library exposes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_SetVoiceByProperties</span></code>, the backend retries using <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_SetVoiceByProperties(languages=selector)</span></code>.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>This is a compatibility strategy, not a BCP-47 implementation in Python. It allows common locale-style selectors such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de-de</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en-gb</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fr-fr</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sv-se</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pt-br</span></code> to work natively without consumers maintaining their own alias tables.</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>CLI:
    eSpeak -v&lt;selector&gt;

Native:
    SetVoiceByName(selector)
    -&gt; if not found:
       SetVoiceByProperties(languages=selector)
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Older eSpeak libraries that lack <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_SetVoiceByProperties</span></code> fall back to name-only lookup. Both failures raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VoiceNotFoundError</span></code> with diagnostic codes for each attempt.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EspeakRuntime</span></code> resolves each <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice=</span></code> request against the active voice inventory and passes the selected concrete identifier to either backend. Matching prefers exact language, identifier, identifier basename, and then base language, in that order, while preserving inventory order for ties. Identifiers are compared case-insensitively with underscores and Windows separators normalized.</p>
<p>Standard language requests exclude MBROLA entries. Explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mb/...</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mb-...</span></code> requests can select MBROLA, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">resolve_voice(...,</span> <span class="pre">allow_mbrola=True)</span></code> enables it for a normal request when no preferred standard match exists. Voice inventory and resolved requests are cached per runtime instance. If a backend cannot enumerate voices, the requested identifier is passed through for backend-level validation.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="cli-backend">
<h2>CLI backend</h2>
<p>The CLI backend starts eSpeak for each operation. An explicit data directory, the environment data directory, or data derived near the selected executable is used before any optional loader data. When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">data</span></code> names <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak-ng-data</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak-data</span></code>, the CLI receives its parent directory through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--path</span></code>, matching native initialization. Otherwise the executable uses its own default data.</p>
</section>
<section id="clause-behavior">
<h2>Clause behavior</h2>
<p>Exact native clauses preserve the complete eSpeak NG terminator code. The six common punctuation constants are comma, colon, semicolon, period, question mark, and exclamation mark. The sentence boundary is derived independently from the sentence-type bit.</p>
<p>Other backends use a documented best-effort punctuation splitter. Its output is useful for migration and ordinary processing, but it is not a substitute for exact native metadata.</p>
</section>
<section id="phoneme-output-semantics">
<h2>Phoneme output semantics</h2>
<p>The native backend supports two phoneme output paths:</p>
<section id="native-trace-cli-equivalent">
<h3>Native trace (CLI-equivalent)</h3>
<p>When the native library exposes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_SetPhonemeCallback</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_Synth</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_Synchronize</span></code>, the backend uses the synthesis trace path. This produces phoneme output identical to the CLI’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-x</span> <span class="pre">--ipa</span></code> mode, including stress markers on weak words and contractions.</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>RuntimeInfo.phoneme_output_api = &quot;native-trace&quot;
RuntimeInfo.phoneme_parity = &quot;exact&quot;
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="native-translation-legacy">
<h3>Native translation (legacy)</h3>
<p>Older libraries or builds without trace symbols use the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">espeak_TextToPhonemes</span></code> direct translation API. This path may produce different stress semantics than the CLI for some words.</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>RuntimeInfo.phoneme_output_api = &quot;native-translation&quot;
RuntimeInfo.phoneme_parity = &quot;best-effort&quot;
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="id1">
<h3>CLI backend</h3>
<p>The CLI backend always uses the eSpeak executable’s synthesis phoneme output.</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>RuntimeInfo.phoneme_output_api = &quot;cli&quot;
RuntimeInfo.phoneme_parity = &quot;exact&quot;
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="auto-mode-behavior">
<h3>Auto-mode behavior</h3>
<p>When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode=&quot;auto&quot;</span></code>, the runtime prefers native trace when available. This ensures <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode=&quot;auto&quot;</span></code> produces CLI-equivalent phoneme output on modern eSpeak NG installations.</p>
<p>The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parity</span></code> field on <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RuntimeInfo</span></code> is preserved for backward compatibility but relates to exact clause API support, not phoneme output semantics. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">phoneme_output_api</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">phoneme_parity</span></code> for phoneme-level diagnostics.</p>
</section>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
